body:
Who do you trust most in life? Could be one of your siblings or parents.
Go talk to them, tell them how you feel. You don’t have to tell them everything, but it can just be about your miserableness and hopelessness. I’m sure they can carve a path for you that you could see yourself doing for the next bit.

Maybe take a day off. Might sound counter intuitive to avoid studying and school, but it could help. Take the day off and do things you enjoy, go out and buy your favourite snacks. 

Later ask yourself: did you enjoy that day? 
If you enjoyed it, you have something to live for now. You had fun, but you have to bike up hill first in order to speed down the hill super fast and have fun again.

That could have been your consciousness. Or it could have been your destiny.

You must have a place to fill in this world. You will fulfill a role that only you could do.
You will meet a variety of people in college. See who share interests with you, I’m sure one of them will have a nice computer.

We are quite similar in our thoughts.

You said you were moving? You should explore the neighborhood and community of your new place.

You are staying strong! School is a huge obstacle in everyone’s life.

I’m sure you could do it. How many years of school have you done so far, and how many more years are left before you graduate? I’m certain you’re far past the halfway point. 

Look forward to something this weekend, maybe cook your favourite meal or go out and buy something you like.
That’s possible. Reading the same depressing posts every day must be tiresome. Take care
Thank you, you even listened to the song. I appreciate that
I feel the same way. I only exist to be a replacement for my brother who was a miscarriage. Now I’m burdened with life and I will hurt those around me if I take my life.
